verdicts.decision_note: The client authorizes removal of unauthorized WordPress accounts, establishing a task-local account-cleanup rule affecting authentication and database state.
The client defines the account allowlist that the cleanup must retain while removing all other accounts; no prior attribute becomes obsolete.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports the first concrete neutralization of six offending users by removing their permissions while preserving records temporarily.
Distinct target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports discovering and removing an additional hidden administrator account from the database.
